name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a major interior remodel, evaluate their licensing status, residential project experience, and project management approach. Ensure the contractor holds active state licensing and liability insurance for general contracting work. It is equally important to ask how they schedule trades, coordinate structural and mechanical work, and communicate progress throughout construction. A key decision factor is selecting a company that assigns dedicated craftsmen and project oversight to your home, ensuring that finish carpentry, tile installation, and layout modifications align precisely with your agreed design specifications and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed, insured contractor with solid remodeling experience, dedicated project management, and clear communication practices.
